counting_rules: Do not count still states, clips, headings, source PNG frames or preview derivatives as additional designs.
Per-pack image/design counts can include related subject alternatives across packs. No global distinct-family total is asserted.
Transition masks and copied proof dependencies are not new surface designs.
Scene compositions reuse existing inputs and add no new source-art designs.
Lantern-flare treatments link to the original flare family and add no new abilities.
The beetle base and any uploaded approved motion extension describe one actor design with additive clips.
The hero has zero newly approved production designs; its one listed entry is a limited original-view study.
Source frame entries are counted across clip timelines, not as unique poses. Shared rest drawings and endpoints can recur; derivative output tiers do not add source frame entries.
Padded import images are derivatives and never additional design entries.
Historical before-images bundled for portable comparison proofs and copied scene/proof dependencies are not additional designs.
A shared ZIP is downloaded and extracted only once, even if it serves multiple logical packs.
limits: Target orthographic elevation 35.2643897 degrees, azimuth 45 degrees and 13 m gameplay vertical span. Generated views remain approximate.
Exact projection controls do not calibrate illustrated source geometry.
60 Hz preview video is not source animation frame rate. Read clip manifests.
No engine integration or frame-rate certification. Actor view studies are not a canonical hero production rig.
The locked C/RUST hero source must remain byte-identical.
